exact.The project collected samples from up to: 该项目从近 1,000 名已故个体中最多 54 个无疾病组织部位采集了样本。所有个体均通过全基因组测序（WGS）进行了高密度基因分型，以评估其基因组内的遗传变异。每个组织的基因表达通过 RNA 测序（bulk RNA-seq）进行评估。表达数量性状位点（eQTL）被鉴定为与邻近基因表达变化显著相关的遗传变异。该项目全面鉴定了组织共享型和组织特异性的人类 eQTL，并为解释许多与人类常见疾病（如心脏病、癌症、糖尿病、哮喘和中风）相关的非编码遗传变异提供了有价值的机制基础。
exact.The remaining whole brain was then shipp: 其余全脑随后被送往迈阿密大学脑组织捐赠库，在那里采集 8-11 个脑亚区。Brain - Frontal Cortex 与 Brain - Cerebellar Hemisphere 在此时重新采样，尽量贴近原始采样位置。在迈阿密脑库采集的所有脑亚区均以速冻方式保存。因此成对的脑区在采样时间（在脑库重采的样本缺血时间更长）和保存方式上不同。

templates.pat: For privacy reasons, NIH policy prevents us from releasing the raw sequence data via the GTEx portal. You must request access via: {{1}}. Protected data are available in the AnVIL repository.
templates.zh: 出于隐私原因，NIH 政策不允许我们通过 GTEx 门户发布原始序列数据。您必须通过以下方式申请访问权限：{{1}}。受保护数据可在 AnVIL 仓库中获取。

templates.pat: Due to the nature of our donor consent, the exact age of GTEx donors is protected data. you can find age in 10-year brackets in the public sample annotation file, available on the {{1}}. To access exact age, you must request access via {{2}}. Protected data are available in the AnVIL repository as described on the {{3}}
templates.zh: 由于我们供体知情同意的性质，GTEx 供体的准确年龄属于受保护数据。您可以在 {{1}} 上的公开样本注释文件中找到按 10 岁分段的年龄。要访问准确年龄，您必须通过 {{2}} 申请访问权限。如 {{3}} 所述，受保护数据可在 AnVIL 仓库中获取

templates.pat: Due to the nature of our donor consent, the race and ethnicity of GTEx donors is protected data. To access exact race or ethnicity, you must request access via {{1}}. Protected data are available in the AnVIL repository as described on the {{2}}
templates.zh: 由于我们供体知情同意的性质，GTEx 供体的种族与族裔属于受保护数据。要访问准确的种族或族裔信息，您必须通过 {{1}} 申请访问权限。如 {{2}} 所述，受保护数据可在 AnVIL 仓库中获取

templates.pat: Only BAM files are available in the AnVIL repository, but these files contain all unmapped reads and it is easy to generate FASTQs from them using Picard tools. We provide a wrapper {{1}}.
templates.zh: AnVIL 仓库中仅提供 BAM 文件，但这些文件包含所有未比对读段，使用 Picard 工具很容易从中生成 FASTQ。我们在此提供封装脚本：{{1}}。

templates.pat: No. RNA-seq was performed using the Illumina TruSeq library construction protocol. This is a non-strand specific polyA+ selected library. For more details, please visit our {{1}}
templates.zh: 不是。RNA-seq 使用 Illumina TruSeq 文库构建方案。这是非链特异性的 polyA+ 筛选文库。更多细节请访问我们的 {{1}}

templates.pat: The publicly available donor phenotypes and sample annotations can be downloaded from the GTEx Portal in the Annotation section of each release {{1}}

templates.pat: Due to the nature of our donor consent, the public phenotypes and annotations are limited. If you need access to protected phenotypes and annotations, you can apply for access via dbGaP {{1}}

templates.pat: The RNA-Seq and genotyping processes are run separately. All donors will eventually be genotyped, but their genotypes may not have been produced and QC'd in time for the current release. Some donors have been excluded from the VCF due to relatedness or for biological or clinical reasons (see also {{1}}).
templates.zh: RNA-Seq 与基因分型流程分别运行。所有供体最终都会完成基因分型，但其基因型可能未能在当次版本前完成生成与 QC。部分供体因亲缘关系或生物学/临床原因被排除在 VCF 之外（另见 {{1}}）。

templates.pat: A lookup table is available on the {{1}} (for release V7, the file is GTEx_Analysis_2016-01-15_v7_WholeGenomeSeq_635Ind_PASS_AB02_GQ20_HETX_MISS15_PLINKQC.lookup_table.txt.gz).
templates.zh: 查找表可在 {{1}} 获取（对于 V7 版本，文件为 GTEx_Analysis_2016-01-15_v7_WholeGenomeSeq_635Ind_PASS_AB02_GQ20_HETX_MISS15_PLINKQC.lookup_table.txt.gz）。

templates.pat: The format of the sample ID is {{1}}.
templates.zh: 样本 ID 的格式为 {{1}}。

templates.pat: {{1}}, a measure of cis-eQTL effect size, is defined as the log-ratio between the expression of the haplotype carrying the alternative eVariant allele to the one carrying the reference allele in log2 scale. Currently, due to computational limitation, only the aFC of the most significant variant of each eGene is available.
templates.zh: {{1}} 是 cis-eQTL 效应量的一种度量，定义为携带替代 eVariant 等位基因的单倍型表达与携带参考等位基因的单倍型表达在 log2 尺度上的对数比。目前受计算能力限制，仅提供每个 eGene 最显著变异的 aFC。

templates.pat: {{1}}, previously known as the effect size on the portal, is defined as the slope of the linear regression, and is computed as the effect of the alternative allele (ALT) relative to the reference allele (REF) in the human genome reference (i.e., the eQTL effect allele is the ALT allele). NES are computed in a normalized space where magnitude has no direct biological interpretation.
templates.zh: {{1}}（此前在门户上称为效应量）定义为线性回归的斜率，计算为替代等位基因（ALT）相对于人类基因组参考中参考等位基因（REF）的效应（即 eQTL 效应等位基因是 ALT 等位基因）。NES 在标准化空间中计算，其量级没有直接的生物学解释。

templates.pat: {{1}}: a significant variant associated with an eGene.
templates.zh: {{1}}：与 eGene 显著相关的变异。

templates.pat: where n{{1}} is the number of reads for transcript/gene t, l{{2}} is the normalized transcript/gene length, and T is the set of all transcripts or genes depending on whether the quantification is at the gene level (e.g. by collapsing transcripts). For additional information, see {{3}}
templates.zh: 其中 n{{1}} 是转录本/基因 t 的读段数，l{{2}} 是归一化的转录本/基因长度，T 是所有转录本或基因的集合，取决于定量是否在基因水平（例如通过合并转录本）。更多信息请参见 {{3}}

templates.pat: We no longer provide expression quantifications in RPKM. TPM is a better unit for comparison of RNA-seq samples. You can convert RPKM as follows (for each sample/column): TPM = RPKM / sum(RPKM) * 1e6. For additional information, please see: {{1}}
templates.zh: 我们不再提供 RPKM 单位的表达定量。TPM 是比较 RNA-seq 样本更好的单位。可按如下方式转换 RPKM（对每个样本/列）：TPM = RPKM / sum(RPKM) * 1e6。更多信息请参见：{{1}}

templates.pat: Derived gene expression data can be downloaded from our {{1}}.This data is available at the gene, transcript, and exon levels. We have released tissue-specific gene expression files in read count and TPM units.We also have combined files that contain data from all tissues. The expression matrices contain one row per gene, exon, or transcript, and one column per sample. The column header contains the sample identifier. The sample annotation file, GTEx_Analysis_v8_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt, contains the tissue site detail (in the SMTSD column) for every sample.
templates.zh: 派生的基因表达数据可从我们的 {{1}} 下载。该数据提供基因、转录本与外显子三个水平。我们发布了以读段计数和 TPM 为单位的组织特异性基因表达文件。我们还提供包含所有组织数据的合并文件。表达矩阵每行对应一个基因、外显子或转录本，每列对应一个样本。列标题包含样本标识。样本注释文件 GTEx_Analysis_v8_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt 包含每个样本的组织部位详情（SMTSD 列）。

templates.pat: The GTEx V8 gene model was creating using the GENCODE 'CHR' file: {{1}}
templates.zh: GTEx V8 基因模型使用 GENCODE 的“CHR”文件创建：{{1}}

templates.zh: 该文件用于创建此处提供的 GTEx 合并基因模型：{{1}}

templates.zh: 用于创建合并基因模型的脚本可在此获取：{{1}}

templates.pat: The splicing phenotype IDs are constructed by LeafCutter, and indicate the intron (chr:start:end) and cluster of connected components (clu_) the intron belongs to. Please see the LeafCutter paper {{1}} and documentation for additional details.

templates.pat: GTEx has not released an official set of mitochondrial genotypes, since there remain challenges in calling these due to heteroplasmy of mitochondrial genomes. The whole genome sequence alignments (available on {{1}}) did include the mitochondrial reference, however, and can be used to produce such calls
templates.zh: GTEx 尚未发布官方的线粒体基因型集合，因为线粒体基因组的异质性使这些判定仍具挑战。不过全基因组序列比对（可在 {{1}} 获取）确实包含线粒体参考序列，可用于生成此类判定

templates.pat: The GTEx tissues are to be considered a population control that is as "normal" as can be relative to the age of the individual. Much is described in: {{1}}
templates.zh: GTEx 组织应视为一种人群对照，相对于个体年龄已尽可能“正常”。大量内容描述于：{{1}}

templates.pat: Protected data for GTEx V8 and future releases are only available in {{1}}. Due to the large size of these data, we recommend against downloading the data, as that will incur significant egress charges. Instead, we recommend that you consider performing your computations in the AnVIL/Terra environment. That will incur compute charges, but those might be significantly less than the egress charges (depending upon your computation).
templates.zh: GTEx V8 及后续版本的受保护数据仅在 {{1}} 中提供。由于这些数据体量很大，我们建议不要下载，因为会产生可观的出网流量费用。我们建议改为在 AnVIL/Terra 环境中进行计算。这会产生计算费用，但可能远低于出网流量费（取决于您的计算）。

templates.pat: Access to protected data is described {{1}}

templates.pat: The protocol is described on Page 11 of these supplementary materials: {{1}}
templates.zh: 该方案见这些补充材料的第 11 页：{{1}}

templates.pat: It is not possible to directly compare these values across tissues. Unfortunately, no computational method can be applied for proper between-sample normalization across the diverse set of tissues represented in GTEx. For further details, please see this paper: {{1}}.
templates.zh: 无法直接跨组织比较这些值。遗憾的是，对于 GTEx 所涵盖的多样化组织集合，没有可用于合适跨样本标准化的计算方法。更多细节请参见这篇论文：{{1}}。

templates.pat: An IRB is not required to analyze raw sequence data from GTEx. Please review the Consenting Donors section in the Materials and Methods section of this paper: {{1}}.

templates.pat: On the GTEx project we use the term Normalized Effect Size (NES), which is the same as the beta coefficient (that is, the regression slope). You can find the NES in our Open Access Data eQTL file {{1}} in the column labeled "slope", as described in the associated README file {{2}}.
templates.zh: 在 GTEx 项目中我们使用“标准化效应量（NES）”这一术语，它等同于 beta 系数（即回归斜率）。您可以在我们开放获取数据 eQTL 文件 {{1}} 中名为“slope”的列找到 NES，具体说明见随附的 README 文件 {{2}}。

templates.pat: The sample annotation file here: {{1}} contains our internal product names for our WES protocols in the column labeled SMGEBTCHT. We used four different WES protocls and these map to WES kits as follows:
templates.zh: 此处的样本注释文件 {{1}} 在名为 SMGEBTCHT 的列中包含我们 WES 方案的内部产品名。我们使用了四种不同的 WES 方案，它们对应的 WES 试剂盒如下：

templates.pat: AnVIL has decommissioned the ability to download GTEx V8 protected data from Gen3. Please use the AnVIL Terra environment to access GTEx protected data. For more information, please see {{1}}
templates.zh: AnVIL 已停用从 Gen3 下载 GTEx V8 受保护数据的功能。请使用 AnVIL Terra 环境访问 GTEx 受保护数据。更多信息请参见 {{1}}

templates.pat: The {{1}} section allows you to look up cis eQTLs which have been precomputed in a +/- 1Mb cis window around the transcription start site (TSS). Significance was determined using a Q-value threshold. At least 70 samples per tissue are necessary to achieve the statistical power needed for this type of analysis.
templates.zh: {{1}} 部分可查询已在转录起始位点（TSS）上下游 ±1Mb 的 cis 窗口内预计算的 cis eQTL。显著性用 Q 值阈值判定。每个组织至少需要 70 个样本才能达到此类分析所需的统计效能。

templates.pat: In contrast, the {{1}} and {{2}} allow you to compute, on demand, an association between a SNP and gene of your choice. The association may be cis or trans. This calculation may be performed in tissues for which we have more than 10 samples. No Q-value filtering is performed and the user is left to interpret the significance of the p-value.
templates.zh: 相比之下，{{1}} 与 {{2}} 可按需计算您所选 SNP 与基因之间的关联。该关联可以是 cis 或 trans。此计算可在样本数超过 10 的组织中进行。不进行 Q 值过滤，显著性由用户自行解释 p 值。

templates.pat: REF stands for reference allele in the human genome reference. ALT stands for alleles that are alternate relative to this reference. The variant IDs are in the format chromosome_position_ref_alt_build. A file mapping these variant IDs to rsIDs for all variants used in GTEx eQTL analyses can be downloaded from the {{1}}
templates.zh: REF 表示人类基因组参考中的参考等位基因。ALT 表示相对于该参考的替代等位基因。变异 ID 的格式为 chromosome_position_ref_alt_build。将 GTEx eQTL 分析所用全部变异的此类 ID 映射到 rsID 的文件可从 {{1}} 下载

templates.pat: Unfortunately, there is a bug in the Google Cloud Console which prevents you from downloading files in requester-pays buckets using the Google Cloud Console. Instead, you will need to use Google's command-line tool, gsutil. You can find instructions for installing gsutil {{1}}
templates.zh: 遗憾的是，Google Cloud Console 存在一个缺陷，导致无法使用 Google Cloud Console 下载请求方付费存储桶中的文件。您需要改用 Google 的命令行工具 gsutil。gsutil 的安装说明见 {{1}}

templates.pat: You can find complete documentation for accessing requester pays buckets {{1}}. You can find detailed information on Google egress pricing {{2}}
templates.zh: 访问请求方付费存储桶的完整文档见 {{1}}。Google 出网流量定价的详细信息见 {{2}}

templates.pat: You can learn more about the releases {{1}}.
templates.zh: 您可以进一步了解各版本，详见{{1}}

templates.pat: The tissue site ID (e.g. 1626) mostly refers to the tissue site. BUT we do not recommend using it for tissue site designation. Sometimes, sample mix-ups occur, and will be corrected, however this part of the ID will not change when that happens. The accurate tissue site info for all samples can be obtained from the "Tissue Site Detail field" (encoded as "SMTSD") in the Sample Attribute file, available on the {{1}} page.
templates.zh: 组织部位 ID（例如 1626）大多指组织部位。但我们不建议用它来确定组织部位。有时会发生样本混淆并得到更正，但 ID 的这一部分不会随更正改变。所有样本的准确组织部位信息可从样本属性文件的“Tissue Site Detail field”（编码为“SMTSD”）获取，见 {{1}} 页面。

templates.pat: To find the sample and subject annotations for samples used in an analysis release, please use the sample and subject annotation files from the {{1}} page.
templates.zh: 如需查找分析版本中所用样本的样本与受试者注释，请使用 {{1}} 页面提供的样本与受试者注释文件。
